summary: Enhance your skills with our Data Governance and Compliance Management Course. Learn best practices to ensure data integrity and regulatory compliance.
lede: Data governance courses cover how to assign data ownership, protect sensitive information, and maintain evidence of controls. For professionals who create, operate, review, or report data controls, the course provides practical ways to build inventories and classification rules, map privacy risks to controls, and plan access and retention. Exercises also develop data quality measures and compliance reporting using repeatable governance artefacts.
audienceIntro: This data governance course is designed for professionals who create, operate, review, or report data controls across business and technology environments. It suits foundation-level learners who need a structured entry point and experienced practitioners who need a common operating model for governance, protection, and compliance coordination.
modules: NIST Privacy Framework and Compliance Mapping
prerequisites: You need basic familiarity with business processes, information handling, or organizational compliance. No programming is required, and you do not need prior certification in DAMA-DMBOK, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27701, or the NIST Privacy Framework. Bring a current data policy, inventory, issue log, or control example if organizational confidentiality rules permit. The course uses anonymized scenarios when proprietary material cannot be shared.
